name: print-social-slate-clean-ui-formula-carousel-cover
title: The Clean UI Formula Cover
whatItIs: A slate-blue cover with vertical hairline column guides, a headline mixing light and bold weights ('The CLEAN UI Formula'), a right-aligned condensed subhead, page marks and a swipe cue with two dots.
whatItMeans: Weight contrast inside one headline gives rhythm, and the visible columns show the theme of structure.
techniques: Alternate light and bold words in a headline
Filled and hollow dots as pagination

vocabulary.definition: Combining light and bold weights in one line.
Visible vertical lines showing a grid.
Filled and hollow circles showing slide position.
